description:
POSITION : 1 
 Need MSTR Sr. Developer 

 Location : NYC United States 

 Full Time Permanent      

 Requisition Details: 

 Summary: 

 Mandatory Skills 

 Strong knowledge of quality processes (SDLC, Review, Test, Configuration Management, Release Management, Defect Prevention 

 Preferred/Relevant Skills (Nice to Have) 

 1 Data Extraction, Transformation and Load – knowledge of how to extract, transform and load data; this would also involve obtaining and making available new data sources 

 2 Experience with Sybase IQ Database – Schema Designing and SQL Programming 

 3 Experience in working in Onsite-Offshore environment 

 Soft Skills 

 1 Good communication (written & verbal English) skills 

 2 Ability to work independently and as part of a team 

 Job Description : 
 
 Purpose: 

 1. Should be able to interpret data models and usage of data modeling tools (ERWIN etc) 

 2. Knowledge on new features of the product and performance tuning
 3. Working knowledge on some RDBMS
 4. Gather business requirements, elicit technical requirements, prepare report specifications
 5. Develop reports, cubes, dashboards, scorecards
 6. Design, develop MSTR reports and integration with enterprise portals, mobile integration, write back to source data based on analysis by the business users, alerts via email, mobiles based on predefined events
 7. Identify and design common functionality
 8. Unit, Integration test the developed components
 9. Promote components across dev, test and production environments
 10. Provide UAT and Implementation support 
 Role Description:  

 • Provide support and expertise to the business community to assist with better utilization of Business Intelligence tools and IT solutions, for competitive advantage measures. 

 • Work with project lead and business users to understand requirements, conduct analysis and recommend solution options 

 • Translate customer project requirements into functional and non-functional specifications for BI reports and applications. 

 • Contribute to and support the organization’s Business Intelligence strategy 

 • Development and deployment of BI Solutions 

 • Work with internal resources during development phases to ensure appropriate knowledge transfer; 

 • Develop, implement and maintain test strategies and plans 

 • Participate in data governance for Organization’s core source systems to ensure reporting requirements can be met 

 • Assist in the development of database and development standards 

 POSITION: 2 

 Need MSTR Architect 

 Location : Warren, NJ, United States 

 Full Time Permanent    

 Job Description:- 

 1. Gather business requirements, elicit technical requirements, prepare report specifications 

 2. Develop reports, cubes, dashboards, scorecards
 3. Design, develop MSTR reports and integration with enterprise portals, mobile integration, write back to source data based on analysis by the business users, alerts via email, mobiles based on predefined events
 4. Working knowledge on some RDBMS
 5. Identify and design common functionality
 6. Unit, Integration test the developed components
 7. Promote components across dev, test and production environments
 8. Provide UAT and Implementation support 
 Requirements:- 

 1. Experience Level : 9 yrs – 12 yrs of experience in Microstrategy. 

 2. Hands-on development/maintenance experience in Microstrategy 9.3, Knowledge/Experience on enterprise portal integration, mobile integration, write back to source data based on analysis by business users, alerts via mail, mobile based on pre-defined events
 3. Be able to architect solutions on MSTR platform
 4. Good conceptual knowledge and working experience on meta data creation, creating report specifications, integration test planning & testing, unit test planning & testing, UAT & implementation support
 5. Strong knowledge of quality processes (SDLC, Review, Test, Configuration Management, Release Management, Defect Prevention
 6. Good communication skills and comfortable in interacting directly with clients
 7. Should be able to interpret data models and usage of data modeling tools (ERWIN etc)
 8. Knowledge on new features of the product and performance tuning
 9. Ability to contribute to proposals taking ownership of the BI/DW solution
 Strong DW concepts, Strong Analysis skills 

 

  


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
